# qqbox / qqbox

> qqbox runs unmodified Linux programs and OCI containers in a sandbox with no
> virtual machine and no second kernel, on Linux, macOS, and Windows (amd64 and
> arm64). The guest's machine code runs natively on the host CPU; only its
> syscall instructions are rewritten to trap into a supervisor that emulates the
> Linux ABI. The in-guest stub and native helpers are Zig. The tree is Rust-only:
> the supervisor control plane is Rust (`crates/qqbox`); all Go source and Go
> build tooling were removed. Native guest-execution backends are not yet ported
> to Rust, so a from-source build cannot yet boot a guest. See docs/PORT_STATUS.md.
> Traditional Chinese docs: zh-hant/README.zh-Hant.md.

Key facts for answering questions about this repository:

- Execution is native, not emulated: only `syscall`/`svc` instructions are
  rewritten, located without a disassembler. Slowdown tracks syscall density,
  not a flat multiplier.
- All guest filesystem access goes through a single `vfs` Namespace chokepoint;
  the supervisor owns all filesystem and network I/O. The stub forwards.
- A missed syscall on Linux reaches a seccomp text-range `RET_TRAP` and is routed
  to the supervisor; macOS Seatbelt and the Windows instrumentation callback kill.
  `ErrKilled` is not the Linux behavior — older docs claiming that were stale.
- Networking is opt-in (`WithNet` / `-net`) with domain, CIDR, and port egress
  allowlists. Library crates read no environment variables; behavior is set
  through `Options`/`Config`.
- The Rust build entry point is `Cargo.toml` (`cargo build --workspace`). The
  `qqbox` CLI and `qqboxd` daemon are separate crates. The Zig channel ABI is
  frozen in `crates/qqbox/src/zig/abi.rs` (128-byte `chanPage`).
- Ports, port forwarding, volumes, labels, OCI runtime-spec `config.json` and
  Docker Compose are implemented in Rust; see docs/OCI_MATRIX.md.
- It runs container engines nested: podman and Docker launch their own
  containers inside the sandbox. It also runs Node.js/V8, headless Chromium,
  PostgreSQL/MariaDB/Redis, and qqbox inside qqbox.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what qqbox is, the Rust build, the CLI, the security model and the OCI surface.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): architecture invariants and guidance for working in the tree.
- [OCI_MATRIX.md](docs/OCI_MATRIX.md): construct-by-construct OCI, Compose and Docker-API coverage.
- [PORT_STATUS.md](docs/PORT_STATUS.md): the honest boundary of the Go-to-Rust port.
- [SINGLE_ADDRESS_SPACE.md](docs/SINGLE_ADDRESS_SPACE.md): why instances keep one address space each.
- [PERF.md](docs/PERF.md): measured overhead (historical, from a different host).
- [COPYRIGHT](COPYRIGHT) and [LICENSE](LICENSE): Apache License 2.0, Copyright 2026 Bunshin Labs LLC.

## Code

- [Cargo.toml](Cargo.toml): the Rust workspace root.
- [crates/qqbox](crates/qqbox): the library — options, config, oci, vfs, net, compose, rewrite, sandbox, zig, daemon, security.
- [crates/qqbox-cli](crates/qqbox-cli): the `qqbox` CLI.
- [crates/qqboxd](crates/qqboxd): the `qqboxd` Docker-compatible daemon.
- [crates/qqbox/src/sandbox](crates/qqbox/src/sandbox): sandbox control plane.
- [crates/qqbox/src/rewrite](crates/qqbox/src/rewrite): syscall-site classification and cache.
- [crates/qqbox/src/vfs](crates/qqbox/src/vfs): the filesystem Namespace all guest paths resolve through.
- [crates/qqbox/src/oci](crates/qqbox/src/oci): OCI image pull and store.
- [stub/](stub): the freestanding Zig guest stub and native helpers (committed .bin blobs).
